trackers.product_line: Placer's SDK in other companies' apps; Placer Labs runs the Placer.ai foot-traffic analytics platform, formerly at placer.io
data_collected: geolocation and proximity data, and time spent near points of interest, from beacon, Wi-Fi and other signals
trackers.monetization_model: Placer runs a foot-traffic analytics platform for customers such as retailers, brands, researchers and ad agencies; its policy says they see only aggregated data and that it doesn't sell personal information (Placer's privacy policy for consumers, updated 2026-04-15).

data_flows.purpose: Your precise location and time spent near places, which Placer says arrive without your advertising ID, for foot-traffic analytics for retailers, brands, researchers and ad agencies
data_flows.wording: According to Placer's privacy policy for consumers, updated 2026-04-15.

consequences.text: In 2022 Motherboard reported that Placer.ai's platform gave approximate heat maps of where visitors to abortion clinics lived. Placer told a US senator that data on 17 Planned Parenthood locations was looked up between 2020 and 2022, some of it by journalists, and it removed the ability to search them.
